derivation: Base supported and conditionally supported production paths, constrained by release_profiles.lgpl-prebuilt. Unqualified input containers are not promoted by compiling their demuxers.

production.audio_contract: AAC packet copy/passthrough or none; native AAC decoding may assist stream probing but no AAC encoding/transcoding is required.

excluded.matroska: Not required: input Matroska is Unqualified; output Matroska is Unsupported.
excluded.mov: Input MOV is Unqualified; required mov demuxer serves qualified MP4 inputs, not a promotion of MOV tuples.

qualification_tooling_not_production.description: Existing oracle tools can use a separately attested FFmpeg tool stack. If the release FFmpeg executables perform these checks, corresponding tool capabilities must be explicitly enabled without changing production support.

retained_regression.accounting_note: All historical 17 retained production paths explicitly encode with VAAPI. portable-h264-sdr is a separate base-support scenario, not one of these 17; its historical GPL-capable qualification remains unchanged.
retained_regression.oracle_policy: Unchanged retained hashes, same-stack strict packet/frame/metadata, existing H.264 semantic allowlist and cross-driver Tier 1B-P; no baseline rewrite.

code_evidence.containers: apps/asciiflow-cli/src/main.rs MP4-only output guard; crates/asciiflow-media/src/ffmpeg/encoder.rs avformat_alloc_output_context2; decoder.rs and audio_reader.rs avformat_open_input
code_evidence.codec_selection: crates/asciiflow-media/src/ffmpeg/vaapi.rs select_decoder and probe_decoder_build; encoder.rs exact *_vaapi encoder-name lookup
code_evidence.audio: crates/asciiflow-media/src/ffmpeg/audio.rs discover_audio_streams, codec-parameter cloning and packet ownership; no audio avcodec_send_frame/encoder path
code_evidence.interop: crates/asciiflow-media/src/ffmpeg/hwframes.rs and hwdevice.rs; DRM PRIME import/export in asciiflow-interop
code_evidence.aac_filter: FFmpeg 8.1.3 libavformat/movenc.c mov_check_bitstream automatically requests aac_adtstoasc where needed
code_evidence.software_av1: FFmpeg 8.1.3 libavcodec/av1dec.c native av1 decoder returns ENOSYS without hardware acceleration; BSD libdav1d supplies retained software AV1 decode
